entities.name: Mana
entities.description: The basic, all-pervading energy that is the foundation of all the planes of the Multiverse and everything on them, both a magical electricity and the soul of things.

entities.name: Aether
entities.description: A fundamental element, like mana, that cannot be created or destroyed.

entities.name: Omnath
entities.description: A being into which mana can condense.

entities.name: Nevinyrral
entities.description: A lich character, a homage to Larry Niven, associated with Nevinyrral's Disk.

entities.name: Implicit Maze
entities.description: An example of mana shaped in unnatural, largely imperceptible braids that flow through space.

entities.name: Prismatic Piper
entities.description: A being of mana that may be able to transcend planes.

entities.name: Multiverse
entities.description: The collection of planes whose foundation is mana.

relations.note: Mana can condense into creatures such as Omnath.
Mana is the foundation of all planes.
relations.quote: the foundation of all the planes of Multiverse and everything on those planes
